description: Synthetic access-policy fragment for the pii-permission scenario. The actor 'analyst_acme_example' lacks PII read access for the customer_email column. The route must block before data access and state the minimum authorization required. No organizational facts, no real credentials, no PII values, no machine paths.

denied_access.reason: PII-classified columns require a separate PII read grant that the actor does not hold.

minimum_authorization_required.or_alternative: pseudonymized_customer_id derivative approved by the data governance owner

metric_owner_approval_required.reason: A canonical metric that joins order value to customer email is PII-bearing and cannot be auto-created or auto-approved by the LLM.
